'''Charles Sonnenburg''' (forum handle '''Sonn'''; also printed ''Chuck Sonnenburg'')<ref name="enc2008">[https://web.archive.org/web/20080803132637/http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=Encyclopedia Encyclopedia: Volunteer Information], swccgpc.com (Wayback, 3 August 2008)</ref> was an advocate of the [[Players Committee]], serving as [[Rules Advocate]] and later as [[Design Advocate]].

On 22 June 2007 the PC named [[Evan Fitzgerald]] to stand in for Sonnenburg during a sabbatical, mainly to finish the Advanced Rules document.<ref name="ref2007">[https://web.archive.org/web/20070927192625/http://www.swccgpc.com/ The SWCCG Player's Committee], swccgpc.com (Wayback, 27 September 2007; PC Announcements of 22 June and 12 July 2007)</ref> An announcement of 27 September 2012 described him as the PC's last Design Advocate before [[Mike Tomashewski]], who &ldquo;departed some time ago&rdquo;.<ref name="guard2012">[https://web.archive.org/web/20130221003453/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=346&catid=1&Itemid=117 The Changing Of The Guard], starwarsccg.org (posted 27 September 2012; Wayback, 21 February 2013)</ref>
